# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This batch of transcripts contains a **large number of short, transactional voice-note calls** — mostly in Tamil with English technical terms — from Crayon Roofing & Structures, a Chennai (Manali / Andarkuppam check-post) based **JSW Steel-linked distributor of color-coated roofing sheets, structural pipes, and roofing accessories/screws**. A significant portion of the corpus is internal logistics noise (crane/vehicle loading, driver coordination, attendance, Porter cab bookings) which has been excluded per instructions. The genuine **sales-relevant calls** are rate enquiries (very high volume — the single most common call type), order confirmations with advance-payment negotiation, dealer/distributor volume deals, accessory/screw orders, GST/billing-name clarifications, one complaint-handling call, one tender-quote call, and one suspicious "consultant/commission" call. There is enough real signal across ~40-50 genuine sales interactions to build a grounded playbook, though the calls are extremely repetitive (same rate-quoting script used dozens of times), so depth on objection-handling nuance is modest.

## Products & brand ladder

**Core product: Color-coated roofing sheets (GI/GL/PPGI/PPGL/Galvalume), sold by brand and thickness:**
- **JSW Coloron Plus** — premium line. Thicknesses: 0.47 mm, 0.50 mm, 0.60 mm (0.35 mm/0.72 mm generally **not available**).
- **JSW Pragathi** — mid-tier JSW line, frequently quoted; price fluctuates often (seen at ₹405, 415, 435, 475, 584 across different days — clear volatility).
- **JSW Kalaran / "Kalavan Plus"** — another JSW variant (₹435–455+tax).
- **JSW L Plus** — "JS-ஆ தான் வரும்" (only comes via JSW, not Tata).
- **Asian Indradhanush** — budget/least-thickness option, 0.45 mm, used when customer wants "lowest cost," color limited to Sky Blue/Off White.
- **Radiance, Nova Blue, Elite Metal Roofing** — brand names mentioned for specific stock/colors.
- Silver/"Steel Bare" (uncoated GL) — cheaper than color-coated, quoted separately.
- **Tata Bluescope** — explicitly **not available** in 0.5 mm ("கிடைக்காது").

**Colors available:** Sky Blue, Off White, Brick Red, Graphite/Pencil/Dark Grey, Royal Blue, Mist Green, non-color "Bare."

**Other products confirmed in calls:**
- **Polycarbonate sheet** (blue, square-meter rate, standard sizes not fixed — made to order).
- **Puff sandwich panels** (insulated sheets, 30/40/50 mm thickness) — company explicitly states: *"நாங்க insulation பண்ண மாட்டோம், நாங்க supply மட்டும் தாங்க பண்றோம்"* [We don't do insulation/fixing, we only supply] — puff is itself **sourced from outside**, not manufactured in-house.
- **Structural pipes** — square pipe, round pipe, MS pipe (sizes/thickness quoted on request).
- **Purlins (Z/C sections)**.
- **Roofing accessories**: Ridge, L-flashing, Gutter (e.g., 150×75), Flash cutter, Deep trim, Down pipe, crimp/curve sheet, GI edge flashing (made-to-diagram, needs width/length diagram for pricing).
- **Fasteners**: Tata-brand self-drilling/stitching screws (various sizes — 1", 19 mm, 25 mm, 5" / 130 mm), hex bolts/nuts, Tata welding electrodes, Tata cutting/grinding wheels.
- **Decking sheet** (JSW make, GSL, varying thickness).

Company is a **pure trading/supply business** — no fabrication, no fixing/installation, no fiber/insulation work. This must be communicated clearly to every customer who asks for "fitting" or "fiber work."
